asset: Grey Kiln target-image depth and single-object reconstruction sources
status: Non-runtime target proxies plus one approved fixed-camera runtime depth backdrop and project-owned colossus sources

mesh_pipeline.cleanup: Blender import, removal of source backdrop/material residue, decimation to 25,204 triangles, stable metre scale, UV texture retention, camera-facing runtime presentation.
mesh_pipeline.distribution_note: Model weights and the 10,512,017-byte raw OBJ remain outside the repository. The cleaned OBJ, 1K texture and mobile FBX are retained.

production_depth_backdrop.purpose: Fixed-camera 2.5D environment reconstruction for the single Grey Kiln combat arena. Fully 3D fighters, combat collision and authored lights remain separate.

image_generation.reference: SourceArt/ReferenceReconstruction/Targets/target_05.jpg (project-owned target image used only for composition and art direction)
image_generation.prompt: Create an original clean environment-only production plate for the Grey Kiln Courtyard, matching the project-owned reference's fixed elevated 16:9 combat-camera composition: a broad cracked circular stone fighting court, two glowing kiln mouths along the rear wall, a monumental broken limestone figure on the right, pottery, bricks, timber racks, soot, ash and restrained fire haze. Use late-sixth-century northern Chinese stone, kiln and timber construction as the historical anchor. Remove every character, weapon, user-interface element, icon, health bar, title and readable text. Keep a clear central combat floor and strong foreground/midground/background separation. Do not copy any commercial-game asset, site layout, logo or proprietary design.

runtime_albedo.processing: Centre crop to 16:9 and mobile 1K resize; Unity sRGB, mipmapped, compressed, clamp, bilinear and CPU-unreadable.

runtime_inverse_depth.processing: Normalize and invert the relative depth, resize to 256x144, keep linear/readable/uncompressed without mipmaps for one-time mesh construction.

runtime_reconstruction.rendering: World-space unlit mesh, double-sided, no probes or shadows. Procedural courtyard renderers are hidden while their combat colliders and authored lights remain.
runtime_reconstruction.limitation: This reconstructs only the visible camera frustum. It supports restrained follow/zoom parallax for the current arena and is not a reusable 360-degree level.

historical_check.real_anchor: Late-sixth-century northern Chinese limestone image-making, pottery kilns, timber racks, rammed-earth/brick construction and damaged paving.
historical_check.fictional_transformation: The sealed Statue Office yard, erased military-register context, giant broken figure and exact composition belong to the fictional Great Heng setting.
historical_check.gameplay_purpose: The central clear ring preserves attack readability; the two kilns and right-side colossus anchor direction and combat spacing.
historical_check.anachronism_check: No Japanese castle silhouette, mature Song/Ming roof density, Gothic masonry, modern industrial equipment or copied commercial-fantasy prop enters the production plate.

InstantMesh.reason: Retained as a later geometry comparison; no output enters this revision.

Hunyuan3D-2.1.reason: Rejected for the global iOS production chain because its community license contains territorial restrictions.

historical_anchor.real_anchor: Late-sixth-century northern Chinese limestone image-making, residual mineral pigment, pottery kilns, timber/rammed-earth/brick construction and inscribed steles, constrained by docs/04A_HISTORICAL_BIBLE.md.
historical_anchor.fictional_transformation: The erased military-register marks, sealed Statue Office yard and broken colossus arrangement belong to the fictional Great Heng regime; no real site plan or commercial-game layout is copied.
historical_anchor.gameplay_purpose: The colossus creates a stable right-side landmark while the kiln mouths, stone rings and wall keep attack direction and circling readable.
